data.title: Cheaper, open and intelligent: Chinese AI models gain ground, as they make inroads in the US
data.description: Chinese AI models are gaining popularity in the U.S. for their affordability and efficiency. More American executives and companies are switching to Chinese models by startups such as DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and Z.ai for daily tasks.
